ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备，或前往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是运用科学知识解决问题，以无数种方式触动着人们的生活。

ex.s: After years of observing human nature, I have decided that two qualities make the difference between men of great achievement and men of average performance curioscy and discontent.

ex.s: Dr Prinstein has also found that the qualities that made the neighbors want you on a play date-sharing, kindness, openness — carry over to later years and make you better able to relate and connect with others.
ex.t: 普林斯坦博士还发现，那些让邻居愿意和你一起玩的品质——分享、善良、开放——会延续到以后 years，使你更好地与他人建立联系和沟通。

ex.s: Both of us had the qualities and virtues that are typical of American actors: humorous, aggressive, and making fun of each other — but always with an underlying affection.

ex.s: Many people now misunderstand emotional intelligence as almost everything desirable in a person's makeup that cannot be measured by an IQ test, such as character, motivation, confidence, mental stability, optimism and "people skills." Research has shown that emotional skills may contribute to some of these qualities, but most of them move far beyond skill-based emotional intelligence.
ex.t: 现在许多人把情商误解为一个人特质中几乎所有无法用智商测试衡量的可取之处，比如性格、动力、自信、心理稳定、乐观和“人际技巧”。研究表明，情绪技能可能有助于其中一些品质，但大多数远远超出了基于技能的情商。

ex.s: It refers to a person's positive qualities.
ex.t: 它指的是一个人的积极品质。

ex.t: 在Tom的品质中，你认为哪些对我们很重要？

ex.s: The likables’ plays-well-with-others qualities strengthen schoolyard friendships, jump-start interpersonal skills and, when tapped early, are employed ever after in life and work.

ex.s: To find out if the special quality was more widespread in birds, the researchers sought the red-backed fairy wren, another species of Australian songbird.
ex.t: 为了发现特殊品质在鸟类中是否更为普及，研究人员寻找红背仙人wren，澳大利亚歌鸟的另一个物种。

ex.s: A machine with a specific purpose has another quality, one that we usually associate with living things: a wish to preserve its own existence.
ex.t: 一台有特定用途的机器还有另一种品质，一种我们通常与生物联系在一起的品质：保全自身存在的愿望。

ex.s: For the machine, this quality is not in-born, nor is it something introduced by humans; it is a logical consequence of the simple fact that the machine cannot achieve its original purpose if it is dead.
ex.t: 对机器而言，这种品质不是天生的，也不是人类赋予的；它是这样一个简单事实的逻辑结果：如果机器停止运转，它就无法实现其原本的目的。

defs.def: a high standard 上乘；优质；高标准

ex.s: A family day out is an opportunity to put aside work, school and other commitments and spend quality time together.
ex.t: 家庭出游是一个把工作、学业和其他事务放到一边，共度美好时光的机会。

ex.s: Quality teaching has been an important reputation-building factor.
ex.t: 优质教学一直是一个重要的声誉建立因素。

ex.s: The New Theatre has been the home of quality drama, musicals, dance and children’s shows for more than 100 years.
ex.t: 100多年来，新剧院一直是优质戏剧、音乐剧、舞蹈和儿童表演的所在地。

ex.s: Quality teaching is one of the most important predictors of a wide range of college outcomes.
ex.t: 优质教学是广泛大学成果最重要的预测因素之一。

defs.def: a thing that is part of a person's character, especially sth good （尤指好的）人品，素质，品德

ex.s: Another attractive quality is experience.

defs.def: a feature of sth, especially one that makes it different from sth else 特征；特质；特色

ex.s: In a study published in Plant Phenomics, Busch and Pereira establish a new procedure for using SLEAP to analyze plant root phenotypes — how deep and wide they grow, how massive their root systems become, and other physical qualities.
ex.t: 在发表于《Plant Phenomics》的一项研究中，Busch和Pereira建立了一种使用SLEAP分析植物根表型的新流程——包括它们长得有多深多宽、根系变得多庞大，以及其他物理特征。

ex.s: As new technologies take on increasingly humanlike qualities, there’s been a push to make them genderless.
ex.t: 随着新技术越来越多地呈现人类特征，人们一直在推动让它们变得性别中立。

ex.s: These qualities, in turn, are mapped onto products that have been assigned a gender.
ex.t: 最有效的生活方式是努力成为那种罕见的混合体——狐狸式刺猍。

ex.s: Learn about the materials and qualities of watercolor paint with experts from the Harvard Art Museums Materials Lab.
ex.t: 与哈佛艺术博物馆材料实验室的专家一起了解水彩颜料的材料和特性。

ex.s: Finally, an attractive quality when job-hunting is a great attitude toward potential job.
ex.t: 最后，求职时一个有吸引力的特质是对潜在工作的良好态度。

ex.s: When St．Augustine admitted his inability to define time， he highlighted one of time 's most noticeable qualities：Time becomes meaningful only in a defined context．Any timekeeping system is valid，and each is as praiseworthy as its purpose．
ex.t: 当圣奥古斯丁承认自己无法定义时间时，他指出了时间最显著的特性之一：时间只有在特定的语境中才有意义。任何计时系统都是有效的，而每一种都因其用途而值得称赞。

ex.s: In conclusion, positive thinking is a powerful and effective tool for dealing with hard times and improving the quality of one's life.
ex.t: 总之，积极思考是应对艰难时期、提升生活质量的强大而有效的工具。

ex.s: He directed some high quality movies.

ex.s: An evolutionary inference can then be drawn. ＂As a parent, do you invest in quality children, or do you invest in children that are in need?＂ Kleindorfer asks. ＂Our results suggest that they might be going for quality.＂
ex.t: 由此可以做出一个进化上的推断。“作为父母，你是投资在优质的孩子身上，还是投资在需要帮助的孩子身上？”克莱因多弗问道。“我们的结果表明，它们可能是在追求质量。”
